simple.summary: דָּגָה (dâgâh) means to spawn , i.e. become numerous First listed occurrence: Gen 48 16.

definitions.full: H1711. dagah [ דָּגָה ] verb multiply, increase (intransitive); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural הארץ בקרב לָרֹב וְיִדְגּוּ Gen 48:16 (E).
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; to move rapidly; used only as a denominative from 1709 ;
